title: WorldCanvas
tagline: Claim your pixel. Shape the Canvas. Verified humans can place a pixel every 5 minutes
description:
Every 5 minutes you can color 1 pixel on a big canvas. The idea sounds simple but captivates millions like shown on r/place or the million dollar homepage. The feeling of community to create somthing together is a very rewarding feeling because of the waitingtime between each pixel placement it takes time to build something whuch gives everything more value. If one pixel takes 5 minutes then a big pixel art will take 100s of hours or a likeminded community that helps in the creation.. Automated bots and unrightious banning of people by admins can destroy this experience. Now it is decentral and every pixel will live forever on the blockchain and cant be taken away from you

This project provides a Worldcoin Mini App available at https://worldcoin.org/mini-app?app_id=app_fcb4b2c59d598913b084654d329b289a&draft_id=meta_fd031329da0b8b7f6fa48f7654eb59b3 as a Omnichain System we also have it deployed on Ronin with the website
how_its_made: This project is sa Worldcoin Mini. For Human verification I use the Worldcoin proof of Humanity to verify that no bots use the platform. I also have a webfronztend deployed where you can use Ronin to place your Pixels on the ronin Chain here you are verified by the Self Protocol on the Celo blockchain. Because on problems with the chainlink implementation these are not synced together
